slides.title: Spoken Tutorial: Creating Your Own API Key
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Creating Your Own API Key.
This key is your gateway to interacting with powerful AI models.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Navigate to Google AI Studio's API Key section.
• Generate a new API key within a project.
• Copy and verify the created API key.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
Here I am using a browser on a computer.
You will need a web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) and an active Google account.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: This tutorial requires Module 2: Art of the Prompt and a Google account.

slides.title: Open Google AI Studio Website
slides.narration:
Open your web browser.
Go to aistudio.google.com.

slides.title: Sign In with Google Account
slides.narration:
Sign in with your Google account.
Enter your credentials.
You are now logged in to **Google AI Studio**.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google sign-in page with credentials input fields

slides.title: Navigate to Get API Key
slides.narration:
On the **left-hand navigation panel**, click **Get API Key**.
This section is where you manage your access credentials for Google AI services.
You will see the **API Key** section.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio dashboard with 'Get API Key' in left navigation panel highlighted

slides.title: Create a New API Key
slides.narration:
Click **Create API Key in new project**.
Notice how quickly the key is generated.
A new **API key** will appear, allowing you to build your own intelligent applications.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio's API Key section, 'Create API Key in new project' button highlighted

slides.title: Copy the Generated API Key
slides.narration:
Click the **copy icon** next to the **API key**.
Think about why securely copying this key is important.
The **API key** is now copied to your clipboard.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio's API Key section, copy icon next to the newly generated API key highlighted

slides.title: Verify API Key Creation
slides.narration:
At this point, observe the new **API key** appearing in your list.
Look under the **Your API keys** section.
This confirms its successful creation and readiness for use.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: Google AI Studio's API Key section, 'Your API keys' list showing the new API key

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we did.
We navigated Google AI Studio.
We generated an API key.
We securely copied it for use in projects.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
For your assignment, create a new Python script.
Paste your API key into it.
Make a simple API call.
Verify its functionality.
